title: Why Did Three Tamil Kings Kill One Generous Chief? | Vel Pari #shorts

lines.text: Why did three Tamil kings kill one generous chief?
Sangam age. Pari ruled Parambu hill, and old poems say he gave its villages to poets.
lines.caps: *Sangam age | *Pari ruled | *Parambu hill | *old poems say | he *gave | its villages | to *poets

lines.text: Legend says he even gave his chariot to a jasmine creeper that had nothing to climb.

lines.text: Then the Chera, Chola and Pandya kings joined together, and besieged his hill.

lines.text: His friend, the poet Kapilar, warned them. Armies would never take it. Singers only had to ask.

lines.text: Yet the hill fell, and Pari was killed.
How? The old poems never say. Later tellings blame treachery, and even they disagree.
